fresh_build.scope: Fresh target directory for each variant; shared registry downloads and OS caches; single trial, not a statistical benchmark.

test_target_rebuild.method: Rebuild only test targets by invalidating their scratch Cargo fingerprint hash files; dependencies remain compiled. Two trials per variant with two compiler jobs; one unmeasured baseline warmup.

interpretation: Two trials per variant: test-target rebuild wall time improves about 22% and CPU about 23% with two compiler jobs. Single fresh eight-job trial is essentially flat; this does not establish whole-CI acceleration. Counts include feature-gated targets; default compilation skips the two old required-feature targets.
